passages.note: Kalra is listed in the Ayes on the Assembly Floor third reading of SB 100; 44-33 is not near-unanimous.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 44 Noes Count 33 NVR Count 3

passages.provision_quote: the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: Chaptered text of the bill Kalra voted for; the amended Section 399.15 carries the binding dated procurement duty, and the Section 454.53 "policy of the state" goal clause beside it does not cancel it (annex rung 1).

rows.reasoning: Kalra voted Aye on final Assembly passage of SB 100 (2017-2018), a single-subject energy bill whose amended Public Utilities Code Section 399.15 binds every retail seller to renewable procurement that achieves "44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030". A legal duty to procure eligible renewable energy resources, attached to those dates, is the rung "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines." (annex H17: a renewable-procurement standard with dated targets is rung 1, unlike an emissions limit). The 44-33 tally is not near-unanimous, so the final-passage vote carries the chair.
